sentences: Per byte i: `D.b[i] = (S0.b[i] + S1.b[i] + (S2.b[i] & 1)) >> 1`, an unsigned average where bit 0 of S2's byte decides whether 0.5 rounds up.
The 9-bit sum shifted right by 1 fits back in its byte, so nothing carries between bytes.
